baseline_models.focus_anchor: نختم على أفواههم / تكلمنا أيديهم / تشهد أرجلهم / بما كانوا يكسبون
baseline_models.mechanism: The preventive seal disables the mouth's ordinary speech outlet. Intelligible address and informed declaration are reassigned to organs implicated in action and movement, making the body an adverse witness to accumulated acquisition.

activation_trace.role: A secured preventive closure removes the mouth as the person's controllable evidentiary outlet.
The mouth is literally the opening used for speech, so its closure marks a deliberate channel switch.
Intelligible speech connecting interlocutors gives the hands a direct address to Us, not merely a vague sign.
Attribution of action and offense to the hands makes their speech evidence from the operative organ itself.
Informed declaration and disclosure make the feet formal witnesses rather than decorative speakers.
Walking on the feet anchors their testimony in the person's pursued course and movements.
Deliberate acquisition supplies the accumulated object about which the organs testify.

changed_reading.before: A silenced person is miraculously contradicted by talking limbs.
changed_reading.after: A controlled evidentiary transfer disables self-defending speech and assigns action and movement organs independent testimony about acquired deeds.

baseline_models.mechanism: The seal can stamp and authenticate as well as bar access; a bodily wound can itself be a speaking mark, and a witness can be a sign. The closed body therefore also reads as an authenticated evidentiary surface bearing the effects of what its organs acquired.

activation_trace.role: Stamping and its impressed mark add authentication to the mouth's closure.
A bodily wound is an effect that can 'speak' by remaining visibly on the body.
A distinguishing sign can stand as witness, allowing bodily evidence to be legible without reducing it to ordinary voice.
The physical hand supplies one surface and instrument on which action can leave evidence.
The physical foot supplies the second bodily surface and instrument of the record.
The image of acquisitive limbs binds bodily organs directly to what was gained or done.

changed_reading.before: The seal only gags, while hands and feet must acquire new voices.
changed_reading.after: The seal also authenticates a body-record whose operative organs disclose deed-effects as voices, marks, or signs.

baseline_models.mechanism: The severe present 'day' closes a previously extended course of acquisition. The imperfect after كانوا presents earnings as recurrent historical activity, so the organ testimony is a terminal accounting of a lived pattern rather than an isolated act.

activation_trace.role: The day as a severe event supplies the decisive present in which the prior course is exposed.
Reaching an endpoint turns the seal into closure of the acquisition period as well as closure of speech.
Occurrence through past time gives the earning clause temporal duration.
Repeated acquisition accumulates the matter now brought to account.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a single extraordinary event on the judgment day.
changed_reading.after: The extraordinary event is the closure and bodily audit of a long, repeatedly acquired history.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier writing of what people advanced, their remaining traces, and exhaustive enumeration supplies a register mechanism. The foot-image inside ق د م and the lasting-sign image inside أثر make the later feet especially apt witnesses: action sent ahead leaves a traversed trace that the body can disclose.

activation_trace.role: The action-attributing hand becomes one embodied location from which the earlier register is read.
Witness as a sign permits the registered traces to function as testimony.
The walking organ physically connects a lived route to the traces it leaves.
Writing and the written object supply the explicit durable-record component.
The treading foot latent in what they 'advanced' bridges prior deeds to the feet that later testify.
A remaining mark that indicates what happened gives the record a trace-based evidentiary form.
Exhaustive counting makes the bodily disclosure comprehensive rather than anecdotal.

structural_cues: 36:12 coordinates what was written, what people advanced, their آثار, and total enumeration in a clear register.
36:65 coordinates hands, feet, and the relative clause بما كانوا يكسبون as sources and object of disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an external-looking register, advanced deeds, surviving traces, and exhaustive count; I infer that 36:65 re-materializes that record in the acting body. A live alternative is that the register and bodily testimony remain separate but corroborating evidence systems.

changed_reading.before: The limbs give new oral testimony alongside an already complete record.
changed_reading.after: The limbs are themselves a readable instantiation or corroborating layer of the earlier record of advanced deeds and surviving traces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from contention to exact recompense for intentional work and then separates the مجرمون. The جرم inventory itself joins earning to offense, so يكسبون becomes a chargeable acquisition whose matching consequence is established by bodily witnesses.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring something for oneself supplies the focus term that the juridical context reclassifies.
Evidence declared from knowledge gives the reclassified acquisitions a formal proof mechanism.
Contention between adversaries supplies the dispute setting in which independent evidence matters.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the exact settlement rule for the testimony.
Intentional work identifies conduct, rather than mere possession, as the matter repaid.
The earning and causing-to-earn branch directly bridges the مجرم label to يكسبون.
Offense and culpable act give that same acquisition a juridical valence.

structural_cues: 36:54 denies injustice and limits recompense to what people used to do.
36:59 separates the مجرمون before 36:64-65 states consequence and bodily testimony.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recompense, intentional work, a disputed setting, and a root that spans earning and offense; I infer that bodily testimony converts accrued conduct into a settled claim. The alternative remains that مجرم merely labels the people and does not lexicalize every instance of كسب as crime.

changed_reading.before: What they earned is a broad label for past behavior.
changed_reading.after: What they earned is an accrued and contested liability whose correspondence to recompense is established by the body's own evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated human contention and controlled قول are displaced by the branch in which a thing's indication is its 'saying.' The known contrast between concealment and disclosure then makes the speaking hand and witnessing foot an evidentiary indication that escapes the person's rhetorical control.

activation_trace.role: The secured gag removes the adversary's controlled verbal channel.
The hands still communicate intelligibly, preserving genuine address after the channel switch.
A bodily sign can witness even if the organ's 'speech' is indicative rather than vocal.
A thing's indication counting as its saying supplies a non-rhetorical mode for bodily speech.
Adversarial dispute characterizes the human speaker whose mouth is denied final control of the case.
Concealment in the interior supplies what controlled outward speech might hide.
Manifest disclosure supplies the direction in which bodily indication moves the concealed material.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly stages denial, argument, and contested قول; 36:77 names the human a manifest adversary.
36:76 pairs their قول with what they conceal and what they disclose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adversarial speech, concealed and manifest material, and a branch where a thing signifies by 'saying'; I infer that the focus replaces advocacy with self-indicating evidence. Literal vocalization of the limbs remains a fully live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The mouth is silenced only so other organs can deliver equivalent spoken sentences.
changed_reading.after: Controlled advocacy is displaced by the body's own indications, which disclose what rhetorical speech could conceal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following hypotheticals erase sight, prevent forward and backward movement, and invert bodily formation. This sharpens the focus's organ-role reversal: feet cease to be merely means of passage and become witnesses to the course they once enabled.

activation_trace.role: Walking is the feet's ordinary function that can be converted into evidence about a traversed course.
Presence and direct observation let the moving organ testify from participation.
Erasing a trace supplies the threatened opposite of the preserved bodily evidence.
Passage and going through name the forward mobility that can be withdrawn from the feet.
Return names the reverse mobility likewise denied, enclosing the whole traversable course.
Turning a thing upside down supplies the explicit body-function reversal that the focus dramatizes.

structural_cues: 36:66-67 follows the focus with sight erased, a path sought, and inability either to proceed or return.
36:68 then describes reversal within bodily creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent hypotheticals of erased perception, immobilization, and bodily inversion; I infer that they gloss 36:65 as reassignment of organ capacities and preserve the feet's traveled history as evidence. They may instead be independent demonstrations of power with no direct evidentiary arrow.

changed_reading.before: Feet happen to be selected as one more miraculous speaking organ.
changed_reading.after: The organ of passage has its mobility suspended and its accumulated path converted into testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, hands mark human making, divine making, human possession, and finally total dominion in His hand. When 'their hands' speak 'to Us,' the focus exposes human operative agency as real but subordinate: the tool imagined as possessed by the person becomes an accountable speaker within a larger sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The hand as a sphere of possession and disposal supplies the human claim to operative control that testimony disrupts.
The working limb makes hand-agency concrete rather than merely symbolic.
Manual craft and skill supply the human-making pole of the hand pattern.
The same craft image attached to 'Our hands' places human making inside a contrasting divine-making frame.
Human possession and disposal establish the local ownership pole that the ending later nests under dominion.
The authoritative hand supplies the final sovereignty frame for all lesser operative hands.
Kingship and dominion make the nesting of human agency under total rule explicit.

structural_cues: 36:35 has human hands in a work construction, while 36:71 has 'Our hands' in a making construction and then calls the humans owners.
36:65 directs their hands' speech to Us, and 36:83 closes with all dominion in His hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a patterned alternation of hand pronouns, work, making, ownership, and dominion; I infer a nesting of human agency under divine sovereignty that becomes visible when hands testify. The live alternative is that the hand idioms serve independent constructions and should not be read as a transfer of control.

changed_reading.before: Their hands testify simply because those hands carried out their choices.
changed_reading.after: Their operative agency remains attributable to them, yet the hands' address to Us reveals that this agency was never outside the dominion that can summon it as witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surprising trigger is a branch under the context term for reclining that describes holding something and tying its mouth, likely a vessel-opening rather than a human mouth. It remains anchored to ختم على أفواههم and the mouth-as-outlet branch, but downstream prose should render it only as a material analogy for channel closure, not as the lexical meaning of 36:56.

activation_trace.role: The secured seal supplies the actual focus operation that the vessel analogy models.
An opening or outlet lets the mouth be pictured materially as a closable aperture.
Holding and tying a mouth supplies the branch-distant container image of contents retained behind a closure.

changed_reading.before: The mouth is simply gagged while other organs speak.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the person is treated as a tied evidentiary vessel: the usual outlet is secured while its contents are disclosed through other bodily channels.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The palm-line image is a remote branch of the root used for what people conceal, so it is surprising and must not become a claim about palmistry or the direct sense of 36:76. It remains valid as a material metaphor because the focus hand speaks and the witness inventory permits a sign; render it as hidden conduct becoming bodily legibility.

activation_trace.role: The physical hand provides the surface on which the exploratory inscription image can attach.
A visible mark functioning as witness allows bodily lines to model disclosure without literal vocal speech.
Lines of the palm and forehead turn the context's concealed interior into an exploratory bodily inscription.
Manifest appearance supplies the movement from hidden conduct to legible bodily evidence.

changed_reading.before: The hands must utter a supernatural verbal report.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the hands 'speak' as inscribed surfaces on which concealed conduct becomes manifest and witness-bearing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The silence and mouth-motion images are branch-distant from رميم in the context's decayed-bone argument, so they cannot be substituted for its direct sense. They remain anchored because the focus redistributes speech across a resurrected body and the same remote inventory holds both silence and incipient mouth movement; downstream prose should present this only as a resurrection-speech resonance.

activation_trace.role: Opening the mouth for speech supplies the ordinary bodily motion that the focus suspends.
Intelligible address survives despite the suspension of ordinary mouth speech.
Silence latent in the decay root resonates with the sealed mouth of the reconstituted body.
Moving the mouth toward speech supplies the opposite pole, sharpening the focus's transfer of speech away from that mouth.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection restores a body, after which its organs independently perform a miracle.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the revived body's own decay-root oscillates between silence and mouth-motion, making redistributed bodily speech part of the resurrection mechanism.

strongest_changes: The record of advanced deeds, surviving traces, and exhaustive enumeration in 36:12 becomes embodied or bodily corroborated in 36:65.
The جرم branches joining earning and offense turn يكسبون into accrued juridical liability matched by recompense.
The post-focus sequence of erased sight, blocked movement, and bodily inversion converts the feet's traveled course into testimony.
The surah-wide alternation of human hands, Our hands, ownership, and dominion recasts hand-agency as real but subordinate and summonable as evidence.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus body function simultaneously as witness, trace-bearing register, and reassigned agency. Especially productive were the foot latent in ق د م, the earning/offense bridge in ج ر م, and the thing's indication as قول.
remaining_uncertainties: The hands' speech may be literal vocalization, nonvocal indication, or both; the packet keeps both mechanisms live.
The foot-image in ق د م and the lasting أثر may be activating resonances rather than intended lexical links.
The hand-pronoun and dominion pattern supports nested agency but does not require a literal transfer of ownership.
The vessel-mouth, palm-line, and decay-speech outliers must remain analogical and explicitly qualified.
